questions.stem: What is the main difference between rough and smooth endoplasmic reticulum?

options.text: Rough ER is found only in plant cells; smooth ER is in animal cells
Rough ER has ribosomes on its surface; smooth ER lacks ribosomes
Smooth ER produces proteins; rough ER produces lipids
Smooth ER contains DNA; rough ER contains RNA

questions.explanation: Rough endoplasmic reticulum has ribosomes attached to its surface, giving it a 'rough' appearance, and it produces proteins for export. Smooth ER has no ribosomes and produces lipids and steroid hormones.
